body: Now, when ※19⛬ checked ※9⛬’s information again:
Category: Rodent ※4⛬
Level: 23 (Normal)
Aptitude: ※7⛬
Attribute: Ground
Height: 1.1 m (Average 1.0 m)
Weight: 32.0 kg (Average 29.5 kg)
Ability: Sand Veil (When in a sandstorm, its evasion rate increases)
Training Method: It is recommended to supplement more energy, as it needs energy replenishment after evolution.
It is recommended to increase ※21⛬ skill training, the specific training method is as follows...
It is recommended to increase speed training, the specific training method is as follows...
At this moment, ※19⛬ also realized that the biggest change in ※9⛬ was not its sudden evolution, nor its one-level increase in strength, nor the two new skills it gained.
Instead, ※9⛬’s aptitude had evolved from ※12⛬ to ※7⛬. This discovery made ※19⛬ uncontrollably excited.
One must know that this was an evolution of aptitude, a miracle akin to defying fate!
How incredible was this!
Although he had collected a lot of information at school before, there were also some methods introduced to change a ※4⛬’s aptitude.
However, they were all vague and perfunctory descriptions, with no specific operational methods, only repeatedly emphasizing that changing aptitude was extremely difficult.
Generally, only when a ※4⛬ evolves, by using some special ※20⛬ or special items, is it possible to improve its aptitude.
That is why ※4⛬ with three stages of evolution are more valuable.
When ※19⛬ saw this at the time, he naively thought that if he could obtain a method for aptitude evolution, wouldn’t he become rich?
But later, after ※19⛬’s in-depth understanding, he realized that methods for changing aptitude were extremely precious and rare.
Only ancient ※24⛬s of the Alliance, and those deep-rooted large families, possessed such methods, and they generally never passed them on.
This was the fundamental reason for the long-term prosperity of those large families; how could they easily tell others the methods?
At most, they would sell some ※20⛬ that changed aptitude, although it only targeted specific ※4⛬ and still had a chance of failure,
But each time it appeared, it would cause a frantic scramble among people, which shows how difficult and precious aptitude changes were.
Of course, this change in aptitude cannot be infinitely improved.
Generally, it can only increase aptitude to ※0⛬ at most. Going further up would require ten times the resources, and there’s a high chance of failure, which would not be cost-effective.
Therefore, although those large families might not lack ※4⛬ with ※0⛬ aptitude, ※4⛬ with true ※6⛬ aptitude were still extremely scarce.
※19⛬ stood rooted to the spot, his body trembling slightly, his eyes fixed intently on the ※9⛬ before him, his heart swept by a storm.
His thoughts, like wild horses, galloped freely among various possibilities.
“Could it be… could it be that my special ability brought all this about?”
※19⛬’s voice carried a hint of imperceptible tremor, as if he was asking himself, and also as if he was seeking the truth from this mysterious world.
His brows were tightly furrowed, his eyes filled with a fervent glow of tension and anticipation intertwined, and fine beads of sweat seeped from his forehead, glistening faintly in the dim cave.
He slowly raised his hand and subconsciously touched his chin, his fingers gently caressing, as if this could help him sort out his chaotic thoughts.
“※9⛬ completed its evolution and improved its aptitude in such a short time, and no other special events occurred during this period.
It can’t be because it was injured by ※11⛬, can it?”
※19⛬ murmured softly, speaking very quickly, as if afraid that his voice would disturb the chain of reasoning forming in his mind.
He began to pace back and forth in the small space, each step carrying his inner anxiety and unease, his feet making slight sounds on the ground, which were exceptionally clear in the silence.
“The only difference is that I previously cleared its energy circulation channels, which significantly changed both the speed and total amount of energy flow.
Could it really be because of this?”
※19⛬ suddenly stopped, his eyes widening abruptly, as if he had discovered a new continent, a look of joyful surprise appearing on his face.
But this joy was instantly replaced by a hint of worry,
“However, is this aptitude improvement truly only achievable during evolution? If so, then this ability, though precious, is not invincible. But if…”
※19⛬’s breathing quickened, his hands unconsciously clenched into fists, and the veins on his arms protruded slightly,
“If simply clearing the energy channels can improve aptitude, then haven’t I mastered the divine brush that can rewrite a ※4⛬’s fate!”
He exclaimed excitedly, his voice echoing in the empty cave, carrying an uncontrollable thrill and anticipation,
His eyes sparkled with a fervent light, as if he had already seen himself standing at the pinnacle of the ※4⛬ world.
However, ※19⛬ quickly calmed down. He gently shook his head, as if to shake these overly beautiful fantasies out of his mind.
“It’s too early to draw conclusions now, after all, I only tried it on ※9⛬, and the specific situation is still unclear.”
He sighed, his brows slightly relaxed, and a hint of rationality returned to his eyes.
“Let’s first check the condition of that energy of mine. If it’s consumed and can’t be recovered, then everything is over.”
※19⛬ closed his eyes, took a deep breath, and tried to calm himself, concentrating on feeling the flow of energy within his body.
A moment later, a look of ecstatic joy gradually appeared on ※19⛬’s face. He suddenly opened his eyes, the light in them like fireworks blooming in the night sky.
“Haha, excellent!”
He burst into laughter, his laughter clear and full of vitality, echoing for a long time in the silent cave.
“This energy actually recovered! It seems my luck is really good.”
※19⛬ excitedly waved his arms, as if celebrating a great victory, his body swaying slightly with excitement.
“And, it seems to have increased a little?”
He tilted his head slightly, with a hint of doubt and curiosity in his eyes, and gently tapped his temple with his finger,
“Is it an illusion? Who cares, I’ll know after letting the system scan it.”
※19⛬ took a deep breath and said to the void with firm eyes:
“System, scan me.”
His voice was steady and powerful, like a resounding bell, filled with an intense desire for unknown answers and a fearless determination to explore the truth.
In an instant, a translucent light screen slowly appeared before his eyes, clearly listing his various information:
Gender: Male
Age: 14 years old
Skills: Junior Breeder, Junior ※20⛬ Maker, Senior Chef
Talent: Unknown Energy
Owned ※4⛬: ※9⛬ (Level 23)
Owned Items: 120,000 money, three liters of ※11⛬ honey, ※10⛬ exclusive Junior ※1⛬, various Junior ※20⛬
data.title: Chapter 8 Qualification Improvement
